annotations.title: Start with Christ: begin, next steps, reading plans

description: PURPOSE: Help someone take a first or next step: what The Living Bread is and how to begin for free, six common journeys run end to end with at most five next steps each, and the multi-day Bible reading plans with one day read in full. WHEN TO USE: "what is The Living Bread", "I am new to Christianity, where do I start", "find me a community near Leeds", "someone to pray with tonight", "where can I serve this weekend", "a prayer group in Spanish", "help me understand and live Romans 12", "a reading plan for anxiety". WHEN NOT: the gospel itself: learn_the_faith (mode gospel). A single verse: read_scripture. A plain list of churches or gatherings: find_churches or find_gatherings. MODES (required parameters in brackets): begin [none] the invitation, the web, App Store and Google Play links, and first steps. next_steps [journey] one of community_near_me, someone_to_pray_with_tonight, serve_this_weekend, new_to_christianity, prayer_group_in_my_language, understand_and_live_a_passage; place for the place journeys, language for prayer_group_in_my_language, passage for understand_and_live_a_passage. reading_plans [none] every plan, or one plan by name or need with one day in full (plan, day 1 to 31). OUTPUT: mode, answered_by, and: begin gives invitation, web, app_store, play_store, first_steps, who_is_jesus; next_steps gives results (at most 5, each with why and freshness), next_step {label, url}, and alternatives when nothing is held; reading_plans gives plans and plan with its days and reading {ref, text read verbatim from the stored KJV, word, step}, or plan null. BEHAVIOR: read only; creates no account and tracks no progress. next_steps reads live data; begin and reading_plans are bundled. Give links exactly as returned. An unknown language returns an error with try_instead; nothing held returns honest alternatives. Parameters a mode does not use are ignored and named in ignored_params. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

day.description: For reading_plans: which day to read in full (default 1).

journey.description: For next_steps: which journey to run.

language.description: For next_steps prayer_group_in_my_language: a language name or ISO 639-1 code ("Spanish", "es").

mode.description: Which kind of answer: begin, next_steps, reading_plans. Each mode, and the parameters it needs, is explained in the description.

passage.description: For next_steps understand_and_live_a_passage: a reference, e.g. "Romans 12:1-2".

place.description: For next_steps: city, region or country as the person says it ("Leeds", "Kenya"); never a street address.

plan.description: For reading_plans: a plan name or a need it serves ("Learn to Pray", "anxious", "grief"). Omit to list every plan.

name: start_with_christ

answered_by.description: The implementation that answered (the same tool name the signed-in endpoint lists).

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

ignored_params.description: Parameters given that this mode does not use.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Start with Christ: begin, next steps, reading plans
